title: Curve sample_baked is not reentrant
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.x

### System information

Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS - Godot Engine v4.6.2 - AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (Vulkan - Forward+) - Intel Core i5 - 13th gen

### Issue description

Calling `sample_baked` from several threads while the curve is baking causes the application to crash.

### Steps to reproduce

Coded a custom `Noise` which uses a `Curve` to alter values.
The methods `get_noise_*` are override to return : `curve->sample_baked(source->get_noise_2D(x, y)` (for example).

Apply the noise to a `NoiseTexture2D`, and modify the curve in the editor (or in code).
A concurrent access to baked procedure (through the `Curve::_bake` method) causes a segmentation fault/crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I have coded a module (which is up-to-date with master) for a while now at https://github.com/CasualGarageCoder/godot-noise-composer

This line in particular is "safe" now:
https://github.com/CasualGarageCoder/godot-noise-composer/blob/20272fb982537198887f36e28eb8abaaa3ed8bbd/noise_composer.h#L235

But if you replace the call to `sample` by `sample_baked`, and use a `CurveNoise` as a noise in a `NoiseTexture2D` and edit the curve, you'll be able to reproduce the issue.

To cope with this, i kinda recoded a reentrant version of the `Curve` ( https://github.com/CasualGarageCoder/godot-curvature ), but it's just a crutch as it require extra maintenance and prevent usage of regular `Curve`.
